::: {.reveal style="max-width:720px;margin:0 auto 4rem;color:var(--fg-muted);"}
I'm a data scientist with **6+ years** building and shipping ML systems across CPG, retail, and real estate. I like problems where the modeling choice changes a business decision — and I care about work that survives contact with production. Most of the numbers on this site come from work I led end to end — framing, distributed feature engineering, modeling, deployment, and monitoring.

Tools I reach for: Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, Spark, Dask, scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, FastAPI, Streamlit, RAG/vector stores, and OpenAI/Hugging Face for LLM work.
:::
